reviews.title: Best sobriety App
reviews.text:
Sobo is a great tool for anyone looking for more accountability in their recovery journey. One of my favorite features is the sobriety tracker because seeing your days add up gives you a reminder of how far you’ve come.

Recovery isn’t always easy, and having something that helps you stay consistent, check in with yourself, and keep your progress in front of you can make a big difference.

It’s a simple app, but sometimes the simple reminders are what help you keep going.

reviews.title: Monetizing off our sobriety?
reviews.text: These apps are horrendous. They get you to sign up to show you how much money you’d save if you quit your habit and then the literal next page is the “$60/year or 7 day free trial” like weren’t we just talking about saving money?? Can any one of these corporations actually care about the humans they’re making these experiences for instead of the money? What if I’m trying to quit a habit that has left me financially unstable, and I’ve finally gotten to the mental point of realization that this habit needs to stop. Then I use that motivation to download these terrible apps and realize I need money to sober up? I cannot stand this greedy rock we all live on.

reviews.title: Amazing!! Must get for sobriety.
reviews.text:
Okay - I am so hesitant to get some of these apps- they want you do to a free trial, then you have to pay, then you still don’t get features if you don’t upgrade.  This app is so much different.  It’s 100% free (at least, so far to my knowledge) and has so many great features!

Also- I am not one to have super long convos with AI, but let me say, the Sobo chat bot does NOT text like ChatGPT does.   It sounds much more personable, like you’re texting a friend.  It genuinely has helped me hundredfold in my recovery.  And the countdown helps remind you of your progress.  Amazing all around.
